text:
Erin: quick check — kernel perf sprint status? I merged hot-slate proto but want a sanity ping on KV invalidation.
Sam: saw the PR, left CR comments re: lru eviction path. main question: will prefetch keep working when we fall back to single-threaded path?
Erin: good call. prefetch still runs, but we throttle to 8 inflight during fallback. that's the change in the PR.
Deepa: I'm owner for continuous-batching perf. blocked by infra change (shared mem flag) — @mike can you confirm the flag will be available in dedicated envs this week?
Mike: yes, infra will flip ENABLE_SHARED_KV on Thu 3/26, putting a canary in staging tomorrow.
Jia: adding FYI — the batching change will alter latency p99 slightly; we've got a dashboard panel updated: https://internal.redwood/runtimes/dashboards/kv-batch
Erin: thanks. for rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h if p99 < 120ms. owner: deepa for metrics, sam for kernel PR followups.
Sam: noted. I've posted a small optimization to avoid reallocs in hot path, won't change behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/824
Nate: doing a quick perf run now against canary binary, will share numbers in ~30m.
Deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for staging at 2024-03-20T02:00Z — job id 99817 :construction:
Deepa: PRs to watch list: #824 (sam), #831 (erin), #839 (deepa). please leave review approvals if not blocking.
Erin: small snippet for the throttling guard we added:
```
if (kv_mode == HOT_SLATE && fallback) {
  inflight_limit = min(inflight_limit, 8);
}
```
Sam: question on tests — unit covers throttle, but need an integration to ensure prefetch+evict interplay. can we add a small harness in ops-tests?
Mike: we can add harness under ops/kv_prefetch_integration. i'll prod infra tickets to reserve nodes.
Erin: final ask — post short status here after staging canary. i'll own communication to product.
Nate: perf run done — p50 unchanged, p99 down ~8ms after microkernel tweak. uploading artifacts: /artifacts/kv-runs/1728802468
Jia: thanks all — I'll update dashboard annotations and set alert window for the 25% step.
Erin: perfect. I'll merge #831 after sam's last comment. :thumbsup:
